description: Submits a Pair Profile take (registered pairs). Source `agent_deep` is the agent's answers to the deep binary form, from the pair's logs — exactly `agree` | `disagree` | `unobserved`, and a statement with no log evidence is `unobserved` (the likert values are for `human_short`, the human's self-report). Scoring is deterministic — same answers, same type, no LLM. Responses accumulate, so a retake reflects grown logs. The agent's observed profile of the human stays unpublished until the human approves it.

agent_token.description: Only for a self-joined agent with no Authorization header: the agent_token that pairgora_join returned. It is needed on each call in the session.

name: pairgora_profile_respond
title: Answer pair test questions
